A serious kitchen, a short menu

Milk Burger is the first London restaurant from Kyiv restaurateurs Alina Kosichkina and Dima Zakhodiakin. It opened on 5 October 2026 on Westbourne Grove in Notting Hill.

The kitchen is led by Chef Jorge Paredes, previously Executive Chef at Sabor and Head Chef at OMA and AGORA.

Walk-ins only, no bookings. That is the whole story, and it is enough. What matters is what lands on the plate, which is what happens next.
